remarks: Welcome to 6938 Almondine Drive, a beautifully remodeled single-story Atrium model ideally situated on a desirable corner location within the Garden Greens community of West Garden Grove. With only one common wall, three private outdoor spaces, and an attached two-car garage with direct access, this thoughtfully designed home offers the privacy, openness, and ease of living that feels much more like a single-family residence. Once inside the light-filled, open-concept interior with soaring vaulted ceilings, recessed lighting, wide-plank luxury vinyl flooring, and expansive dual-pane windows create a bright and inviting atmosphere.
